#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A1 portrait poster about global education.
Fully fills the A1 canvas with a data-driven narrative design."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ── A1 at 300 DPI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 7016, 9933
DPI = 300
CX = W // 2  # center x

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG      = (10, 22, 38)       # deep navy
CARD_BG = (22, 35, 53)       # card surface
CARD_BG2 = (28, 43, 62)      # lighter card
AMBER   = (244, 162, 97)     # warm accent
AMBER2  = (255, 183, 77)     # brighter amber
CORAL   = (231, 111, 81)     # urgent accent
WHITE   = (238, 243, 247)    # primary text
GRAY    = (170, 183, 194)    # secondary text
DIM     = (95, 112, 128)     # dim text
GREEN   = (102, 187, 106)    # positive
DARK_ACCENT = (52, 65, 82)   # subtle line

# ── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FB = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
f = lambda name, size: ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FB, name), size)

def get_font(size, bold=True, italic=False):
    if bold and italic:
        return f("LiberationSans-BoldItalic.ttf", size)
    elif bold:
        return f("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", size)
    else:
        return f("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", size)

# ── Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def card(draw, xy, radius=24, fill=CARD_BG):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.rectangle([x1+r, y1, x2-r, y2], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x1, y1+r, x2, y2-r], fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y1, x1+2*r, y1+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y1, x2, y1+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y2-2*r, x1+2*r, y2], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y2, x2, y2], 0, 90, fill=fill)

def hline(draw, x1, x2, y, fill, w=2):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill, width=w)

def tc(draw, xy, text, font, fill):
    """Text centered at xy (mm anchor)."""
    draw.text(xy, text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="mm")

def tl(draw, x, y, text, font, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="la")

def tw(text, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

# ── Layout parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
M = 280                        # margin
CW = W - 2*M                   # content width
HEADER_GAP = 24                # gap between section header and card
SECTION_GAP = 110              # gap between sections

y = 180                        # current vertical position

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 0: TOP BRAND BAR & TITLE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Thin decorative line at top
hline(draw, M, M + 500, 100, AMBER, 5)

# Main title
title_f = get_font(148, bold=True)
sub_f   = get_font(80, bold=True)
desc_f  = get_font(52, bold=False)

ttxt = "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION"
tw1, th1 = tw(ttxt, title_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th1//2), ttxt, title_f, WHITE)
y += th1 + 40

stxt = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
tw2, th2 = tw(stxt, sub_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th2//2), stxt, sub_f, AMBER)
y += th2 + 30

dtxt = "How far the world has come — and the critical gaps that remain"
tw3, th3 = tw(dtxt, desc_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th3//2), dtxt, desc_f, GRAY)
y += th3 + 70

# Decorative divider
hline(draw, CX - 500, CX + 500, y, AMBER, 3)
y += SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sec_f   = get_font(48, bold=True)

tc(draw, (CX, y), "01  —  TWO CENTURIES OF EDUCATIONAL EXPANSION", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD1_H = 1150
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD1_H))
card_y1 = y

# Two big circles: 1800 (1/5) vs TODAY (4/5)
left_x  = M + int(CW * 0.26)
right_x = M + int(CW * 0.74)
cy      = card_y1 + 130

# --- LEFT: 1800 circle ---
lb_f = get_font(42, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_x, cy), "1800", lb_f, GRAY)

r_small = 195
circle_top = cy + 80
circle_bot = circle_top + 2*r_small
ccy = circle_top + r_small

# Outline circle
draw.ellipse([left_x - r_small, circle_top, left_x + r_small, circle_bot],
             outline=DIM, width=7)
# Fill 1/5 (72 degrees)
draw.pieslice([left_x - r_small, circle_top, left_x + r_small, circle_bot],
              -90, -18, fill=(80, 100, 120))

# "1/5" inside
big_f = get_font(120, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_x, ccy), "1/5", big_f, DIM)
lab_f = get_font(36, bold=False)
tc(draw, (left_x, circle_bot + 70), "adults had any\nformal education", lab_f, DIM)

# --- Arrow ---
arr_y = ccy
arr_x1 = left_x + r_small + 50
arr_x2 = right_x - r_small - 50
hline(draw, arr_x1, arr_x2, arr_y, AMBER, 5)
# Arrowhead
ah = 30
draw.polygon([(arr_x2, arr_y), (arr_x2-ah, arr_y-ah//2), (arr_x2-ah, arr_y+ah//2)], fill=AMBER)
# Label
arr_f = get_font(38, bold=True, italic=True)
tc(draw, ((arr_x1+arr_x2)//2, arr_y - 55), "Two centuries of educational expansion", arr_f, AMBER)

# --- RIGHT: TODAY circle ---
tc(draw, (right_x, cy), "TODAY", lb_f, WHITE)

r_large = 240
circle_top2 = cy + 60
circle_bot2 = circle_top2 + 2*r_large
ccy2 = circle_top2 + r_large

draw.ellipse([right_x - r_large, circle_top2, right_x + r_large, circle_bot2],
             outline=AMBER, width=8)
# Fill 4/5 (288 degrees) with bright amber
draw.pieslice([right_x - r_large, circle_top2, right_x + r_large, circle_bot2],
              -90, 198, fill=AMBER2)
# Inner circle (donut)
inner_r = 155
draw.ellipse([right_x - inner_r, ccy2 - inner_r, right_x + inner_r, ccy2 + inner_r],
             fill=CARD_BG)
tc(draw, (right_x, ccy2), "4/5", big_f, AMBER)
tc(draw, (right_x, circle_bot2 + 70), "adults have\nformal education", lab_f, GRAY)

# Small stat labels year/percentage markers below circles
stat_line_y = circle_bot2 + 160
# Literacy callout
lit_f = get_font(40, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, stat_line_y),
   "Literacy rates have followed the same trajectory — from very few to the vast majority",
   lit_f, GRAY)

y += CARD1_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: 244 MILLION — DOMINANT VISUAL ANCHOR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "02  —  244 MILLION CHILDREN STILL OUT OF SCHOOL", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD2_H = 2100
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD2_H))
card2_y = y

# Massive number "244"
huge_f  = get_font(520, bold=True)
mill_f  = get_font(160, bold=True)
label_f = get_font(52, bold=False)

txt_244 = "244"
tw244, th244 = tw(txt_244, huge_f)
num_y = card2_y + 280
tc(draw, (CX, num_y), txt_244, huge_f, CORAL)

# "MILLION" below
tc(draw, (CX, num_y + th244//2 + 80), "MILLION", mill_f, WHITE)

# Subtitle
tc(draw, (CX, num_y + th244//2 + 240),
   "children of official school age were not enrolled in primary or secondary education in 2023",
   label_f, GRAY)

# Visual: icon grid representing children
# 16x16 grid of small circles, 244 filled out of 256
grid_cols = 16
grid_rows = 16
dot_r = 10
dot_spacing = 32
grid_total = grid_cols * grid_rows  # 256
grid_w = grid_cols * dot_spacing
grid_h = grid_rows * dot_spacing
grid_x = CX - grid_w // 2
grid_y = num_y + th244//2 + 380

filled = 0
for row in range(grid_rows):
    for col in range(grid_cols):
        dx = grid_x + col * dot_spacing + dot_spacing // 2
        dy = grid_y + row * dot_spacing + dot_spacing // 2
        if filled < 244:
            # Filled dot (a child out of school)
            color = CORAL if filled < 184 else (220, 130, 100)  # secondary darker for last 60
            draw.ellipse([dx-dot_r, dy-dot_r, dx+dot_r, dy+dot_r], fill=color)
        else:
            # Empty dot (in school)
            draw.ellipse([dx-dot_r, dy-dot_r, dx+dot_r, dy+dot_r], fill=(40, 55, 75))
        filled += 1

# Grid legend
legend_y = grid_y + grid_h + 40
dot_leg_x = grid_x
dot_leg_f = get_font(30, bold=False)
# Coral dot
draw.ellipse([dot_leg_x, legend_y-6, dot_leg_x+12, legend_y+6], fill=CORAL)
tl(draw, dot_leg_x+22, legend_y-4, "1 dot = ~1 million children out of school", dot_leg_f, GRAY)

# Breakdown cards
break_y = legend_y + 80
card_w = 900
card_h = 320
gap = 70
total_w = 2*card_w + gap
bx = CX - total_w//2

items = [
    ("~60 million", "Primary-age children\nout of school", AMBER),
    ("~184 million", "Secondary-age adolescents\nout of school", CORAL),
]
for i, (num, desc, accent) in enumerate(items):
    cx_ = bx + i*(card_w+gap)
    cy_ = break_y
    card(draw, (cx_, cy_, cx_+card_w, cy_+card_h), fill=CARD_BG2)
    # Left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([cx_, cy_, cx_+6, cy_+card_h], fill=accent)
    n_f = get_font(80, bold=True)
    d_f = get_font(38, bold=False)
    tc(draw, (cx_+card_w//2, cy_+100), num, n_f, accent)
    tc(draw, (cx_+card_w//2, cy_+200), desc, d_f, GRAY)

# "Major driver" callout
driver_y = break_y + card_h + 60
driver_f = get_font(42, bold=True, italic=True)
tc(draw, (CX, driver_y),
   "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who finish primary school do not continue",
   driver_f, AMBER)

y += CARD2_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: THE LEARNING CRISIS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "03  —  THE LEARNING CRISIS: ENROLLMENT ≠ LEARNING", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD3_H = 1100
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD3_H))
card3_y = y

# Left: Giant stat
fewer_f = get_font(200, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 240), "< 20%", fewer_f, CORAL)

explain_f = get_font(50, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 550),
   "of children in lower-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency",
   explain_f, GRAY)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 630),
   "by the end of primary school — they cannot identify key ideas in a text",
   explain_f, GRAY)

# "Being in school ≠ Learning" prominent
ne_f = get_font(72, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 840),
   "Being enrolled does not guarantee quality learning",
   ne_f, WHITE)

y += CARD3_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4: QUALITY INEQUALITY — A WORLD DIVIDED
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "04  —  LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING: A WORLD DIVIDED", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD4_H = 1550
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD4_H))
card4_y = y

# Explanation
exp_f = get_font(46, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, card4_y + 100),
   "Combining years of enrollment with actual learning outcomes reveals stark disparities",
   exp_f, GRAY)

# Two side-by-side bars
bar_w = 140
bar_area_top = card4_y + 280
bar_area_bot = card4_y + CARD4_H - 250
bar_max_h = bar_area_bot - bar_area_top
px_per_year = bar_max_h / 11  # 11 years max scale

left_bar_x = M + int(CW * 0.28)
right_bar_x = M + int(CW * 0.72)

# Poorest countries bar (~2.5 years)
poor_h = int(2.5 * px_per_year)
poor_top = bar_area_bot - poor_h
card(draw, (left_bar_x - bar_w//2, poor_top, left_bar_x + bar_w//2, bar_area_bot),
     fill=AMBER, radius=14)

# Richest countries bar (10 years)
rich_h = int(10 * px_per_year)
rich_top = bar_area_bot - rich_h
card(draw, (right_bar_x - bar_w//2, rich_top, right_bar_x + bar_w//2, bar_area_bot),
     fill=GREEN, radius=14)

# Value labels above bars
val_f = get_font(140, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, poor_top - 110), "< 3", val_f, CORAL)
yr_f = get_font(56, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, poor_top - 180), "years", yr_f, CORAL)

tc(draw, (right_bar_x, rich_top - 110), "10+", val_f, GREEN)
tc(draw, (right_bar_x, rich_top - 180), "years", yr_f, GREEN)

# Labels below bars
below_f = get_font(44, bold=False)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 80), "Poorest countries", get_font(48, bold=True), WHITE)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 140), "(parts of Sub-Saharan Africa)", below_f, DIM)

tc(draw, (right_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 80), "High-income countries", get_font(48, bold=True), WHITE)

# VS in between
tc(draw, ((left_bar_x + right_bar_x)//2, bar_area_top + bar_max_h//2 - 60), "VS",
   get_font(90, bold=True), DIM)

# Middle section: sub-Sahara / South Asia average
mid_label_y = card4_y + 220
tc(draw, (CX, mid_label_y),
   "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling in wealthy countries",
   get_font(46, bold=True, italic=True), WHITE)

y += CARD4_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5: CLOSING THE GENDER GAP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "05  —  CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD5_H = 900

card5_y = y

    ("PRIMARY", "Nearly closed globally", 0.95, GREEN),
    ("SECONDARY", "Nearly closed globally", 0.93, GREEN),
    ("TERTIARY", "Women now exceed men in enrollment", 1.12, AMBER),
]

bar_w_total = bar_r - bar_l
gen_bar_h = 36

for i, (level, status, ratio, color) in enumerate(gender_items):
    gy = card5_y + 140 + i * 230

    # Level label
    tl(draw, bar_l, gy - 20, level, get_font(52, bold=True), WHITE)

    # Bar bg
    by = gy + 50
    draw.rectangle([bar_l, by, bar_r, by + gen_bar_h], fill=CARD_BG2)

    # Filled portion
    fill_w = int(bar_w_total * min(ratio, 1.05))
    draw.rectangle([bar_l, by, bar_l + fill_w, by + gen_bar_h], fill=color)

    # 100% parity line
    parity_x = bar_l + int(bar_w_total * 1.0)
    hline(draw, parity_x, parity_x, by - 12, GRAY, 2)
    hline(draw, parity_x, parity_x, by + gen_bar_h + 12, GRAY, 2)

    # Status text
    tl(draw, bar_l, by + gen_bar_h + 25, status, get_font(42, bold=False), GRAY)

    # 100% marker
    if i == 0:
        tc(draw, (parity_x, by - 35), "100%\nparity", get_font(30, bold=False), DIM)

    # For tertiary, add an overflow indicator
    if ratio > 1.0:
        tc(draw, (parity_x + 50, by + gen_bar_h//2), "+", get_font(36, bold=True), AMBER)

# Caveat
tc(draw, (CX, card5_y + CARD5_H - 60),
   "Significant exceptions persist — in Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school at any level",
   get_font(34, bold=True, italic=True), DIM)

y += CARD5_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 6: KEY TAKEAWAY
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Final content card
takeaway_h = 500
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+takeaway_h), fill=CARD_BG2, radius=24)
# Left amber accent bar
draw.rectangle([M, y, M+8, y+takeaway_h], fill=AMBER)

tw_f = get_font(48, bold=True)
tw_text = (
    "The world has achieved remarkable progress — but the job is far from done. "
    "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
    "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning — and between rich and poor nations — "
    "is one of the most pressing challenges of our time."
)

# Manual wrap
words = tw_text.split()
lines = []
cur = ""
for w in words:
    test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
    tww, _ = tw(test, tw_f)
    if tww < CW - 120:
        cur = test
    else:
        lines.append(cur)
        cur = w
if cur:
    lines.append(cur)

txt_y = y + takeaway_h//2 - (len(lines) * 38)
for line in lines:
    tc(draw, (CX, txt_y), line, tw_f, WHITE)
    txt_y += 76

y += takeaway_h + 70

# Source line
src_f = get_font(32, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, y),
   "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Our World in Data  (2020–2023)",
   src_f, DIM)
y += 50

# Bottom accent line
hline(draw, CX - 400, CX + 400, y + 30, AMBER, 4)

# ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG")
fsize_mb = os.path.getsize(out) / 1024 / 1024

# Print layout summary
print(f"Saved: {out}")
print(f"Size: {W}x{H}px ({W/DPI:.1f}x{H/DPI:.1f}in) | {fsize_mb:.1f}MB")
print(f"Content fills y=120 to y={y+40} of {H} (bottom margin: {H-(y+40)}px = {(H-(y+40))/DPI:.1f}in)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A1 portrait poster about global education.
Fully fills the A1 canvas with a data-driven narrative design."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ── A1 at 300 DPI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 7016, 9933
DPI = 300
CX = W // 2  # center x

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG      = (10, 22, 38)       # deep navy
CARD_BG = (22, 35, 53)       # card surface
CARD_BG2 = (28, 43, 62)      # lighter card
AMBER   = (244, 162, 97)     # warm accent
AMBER2  = (255, 183, 77)     # brighter amber
CORAL   = (231, 111, 81)     # urgent accent
WHITE   = (238, 243, 247)    # primary text
GRAY    = (170, 183, 194)    # secondary text
DIM     = (95, 112, 128)     # dim text
GREEN   = (102, 187, 106)    # positive
DARK_ACCENT = (52, 65, 82)   # subtle line

# ── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FB = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
f = lambda name, size: ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FB, name), size)

def get_font(size, bold=True, italic=False):
    if bold and italic:
        return f("LiberationSans-BoldItalic.ttf", size)
    elif bold:
        return f("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", size)
    else:
        return f("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", size)

# ── Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def card(draw, xy, radius=24, fill=CARD_BG):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.rectangle([x1+r, y1, x2-r, y2], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x1, y1+r, x2, y2-r], fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y1, x1+2*r, y1+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y1, x2, y1+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y2-2*r, x1+2*r, y2], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y2, x2, y2], 0, 90, fill=fill)

def hline(draw, x1, x2, y, fill, w=2):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill, width=w)

def tc(draw, xy, text, font, fill):
    """Text centered at xy (mm anchor)."""
    draw.text(xy, text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="mm")

def tl(draw, x, y, text, font, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="la")

def tw(text, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

# ── Layout parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
M = 280                        # margin
CW = W - 2*M                   # content width
HEADER_GAP = 24                # gap between section header and card
SECTION_GAP = 110              # gap between sections

y = 180                        # current vertical position

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 0: TOP BRAND BAR & TITLE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Thin decorative line at top
hline(draw, M, M + 500, 100, AMBER, 5)

# Main title
title_f = get_font(148, bold=True)
sub_f   = get_font(80, bold=True)
desc_f  = get_font(52, bold=False)

ttxt = "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION"
tw1, th1 = tw(ttxt, title_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th1//2), ttxt, title_f, WHITE)
y += th1 + 40

stxt = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
tw2, th2 = tw(stxt, sub_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th2//2), stxt, sub_f, AMBER)
y += th2 + 30

dtxt = "How far the world has come — and the critical gaps that remain"
tw3, th3 = tw(dtxt, desc_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th3//2), dtxt, desc_f, GRAY)
y += th3 + 70

# Decorative divider
hline(draw, CX - 500, CX + 500, y, AMBER, 3)
y += SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sec_f   = get_font(48, bold=True)

tc(draw, (CX, y), "01  —  TWO CENTURIES OF EDUCATIONAL EXPANSION", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD1_H = 1150
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD1_H))
card_y1 = y

# Two big circles: 1800 (1/5) vs TODAY (4/5)
left_x  = M + int(CW * 0.26)
right_x = M + int(CW * 0.74)
cy      = card_y1 + 130

# --- LEFT: 1800 circle ---
lb_f = get_font(42, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_x, cy), "1800", lb_f, GRAY)

r_small = 195
circle_top = cy + 80
circle_bot = circle_top + 2*r_small
ccy = circle_top + r_small

# Outline circle
draw.ellipse([left_x - r_small, circle_top, left_x + r_small, circle_bot],
             outline=DIM, width=7)
# Fill 1/5 (72 degrees)
draw.pieslice([left_x - r_small, circle_top, left_x + r_small, circle_bot],
              -90, -18, fill=(80, 100, 120))

# "1/5" inside
big_f = get_font(120, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_x, ccy), "1/5", big_f, DIM)
lab_f = get_font(36, bold=False)
tc(draw, (left_x, circle_bot + 70), "adults had any\nformal education", lab_f, DIM)

# --- Arrow ---
arr_y = ccy
arr_x1 = left_x + r_small + 50
arr_x2 = right_x - r_small - 50
hline(draw, arr_x1, arr_x2, arr_y, AMBER, 5)
# Arrowhead
ah = 30
draw.polygon([(arr_x2, arr_y), (arr_x2-ah, arr_y-ah//2), (arr_x2-ah, arr_y+ah//2)], fill=AMBER)
# Label
arr_f = get_font(38, bold=True, italic=True)
tc(draw, ((arr_x1+arr_x2)//2, arr_y - 55), "Two centuries of educational expansion", arr_f, AMBER)

# --- RIGHT: TODAY circle ---
tc(draw, (right_x, cy), "TODAY", lb_f, WHITE)

r_large = 240
circle_top2 = cy + 60
circle_bot2 = circle_top2 + 2*r_large
ccy2 = circle_top2 + r_large

draw.ellipse([right_x - r_large, circle_top2, right_x + r_large, circle_bot2],
             outline=AMBER, width=8)
# Fill 4/5 (288 degrees) with bright amber
draw.pieslice([right_x - r_large, circle_top2, right_x + r_large, circle_bot2],
              -90, 198, fill=AMBER2)
# Inner circle (donut)
inner_r = 155
draw.ellipse([right_x - inner_r, ccy2 - inner_r, right_x + inner_r, ccy2 + inner_r],
             fill=CARD_BG)
tc(draw, (right_x, ccy2), "4/5", big_f, AMBER)
tc(draw, (right_x, circle_bot2 + 70), "adults have\nformal education", lab_f, GRAY)

# Small stat labels year/percentage markers below circles
stat_line_y = circle_bot2 + 160
# Literacy callout
lit_f = get_font(40, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, stat_line_y),
   "Literacy rates have followed the same trajectory — from very few to the vast majority",
   lit_f, GRAY)

y += CARD1_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: 244 MILLION — DOMINANT VISUAL ANCHOR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "02  —  244 MILLION CHILDREN STILL OUT OF SCHOOL", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD2_H = 2100
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD2_H))
card2_y = y

# Massive number "244"
huge_f  = get_font(520, bold=True)
mill_f  = get_font(160, bold=True)
label_f = get_font(52, bold=False)

txt_244 = "244"
tw244, th244 = tw(txt_244, huge_f)
num_y = card2_y + 280
tc(draw, (CX, num_y), txt_244, huge_f, CORAL)

# "MILLION" below
tc(draw, (CX, num_y + th244//2 + 80), "MILLION", mill_f, WHITE)

# Subtitle
tc(draw, (CX, num_y + th244//2 + 240),
   "children of official school age were not enrolled in primary or secondary education in 2023",
   label_f, GRAY)

# Visual: icon grid representing children
# 16x16 grid of small circles, 244 filled out of 256
grid_cols = 16
grid_rows = 16
dot_r = 10
dot_spacing = 32
grid_total = grid_cols * grid_rows  # 256
grid_w = grid_cols * dot_spacing
grid_h = grid_rows * dot_spacing
grid_x = CX - grid_w // 2
grid_y = num_y + th244//2 + 380

filled = 0
for row in range(grid_rows):
    for col in range(grid_cols):
        dx = grid_x + col * dot_spacing + dot_spacing // 2
        dy = grid_y + row * dot_spacing + dot_spacing // 2
        if filled < 244:
            # Filled dot (a child out of school)
            color = CORAL if filled < 184 else (220, 130, 100)  # secondary darker for last 60
            draw.ellipse([dx-dot_r, dy-dot_r, dx+dot_r, dy+dot_r], fill=color)
        else:
            # Empty dot (in school)
            draw.ellipse([dx-dot_r, dy-dot_r, dx+dot_r, dy+dot_r], fill=(40, 55, 75))
        filled += 1

# Grid legend
legend_y = grid_y + grid_h + 40
dot_leg_x = grid_x
dot_leg_f = get_font(30, bold=False)
# Coral dot
draw.ellipse([dot_leg_x, legend_y-6, dot_leg_x+12, legend_y+6], fill=CORAL)
tl(draw, dot_leg_x+22, legend_y-4, "1 dot = ~1 million children out of school", dot_leg_f, GRAY)

# Breakdown cards
break_y = legend_y + 80
card_w = 900
card_h = 320
gap = 70
total_w = 2*card_w + gap
bx = CX - total_w//2

items = [
    ("~60 million", "Primary-age children\nout of school", AMBER),
    ("~184 million", "Secondary-age adolescents\nout of school", CORAL),
]
for i, (num, desc, accent) in enumerate(items):
    cx_ = bx + i*(card_w+gap)
    cy_ = break_y
    card(draw, (cx_, cy_, cx_+card_w, cy_+card_h), fill=CARD_BG2)
    # Left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([cx_, cy_, cx_+6, cy_+card_h], fill=accent)
    n_f = get_font(80, bold=True)
    d_f = get_font(38, bold=False)
    tc(draw, (cx_+card_w//2, cy_+100), num, n_f, accent)
    tc(draw, (cx_+card_w//2, cy_+200), desc, d_f, GRAY)

# "Major driver" callout
driver_y = break_y + card_h + 60
driver_f = get_font(42, bold=True, italic=True)
tc(draw, (CX, driver_y),
   "Secondary-level dropout is the major driver — many who finish primary school do not continue",
   driver_f, AMBER)

y += CARD2_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: THE LEARNING CRISIS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "03  —  THE LEARNING CRISIS: ENROLLMENT ≠ LEARNING", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD3_H = 1100
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD3_H))
card3_y = y

# Left: Giant stat
fewer_f = get_font(200, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 240), "< 20%", fewer_f, CORAL)

explain_f = get_font(50, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 550),
   "of children in lower-income countries achieve minimum reading proficiency",
   explain_f, GRAY)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 630),
   "by the end of primary school — they cannot identify key ideas in a text",
   explain_f, GRAY)

# "Being in school ≠ Learning" prominent
ne_f = get_font(72, bold=True)
tc(draw, (CX, card3_y + 840),
   "Being enrolled does not guarantee quality learning",
   ne_f, WHITE)

y += CARD3_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4: QUALITY INEQUALITY — A WORLD DIVIDED
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "04  —  LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING: A WORLD DIVIDED", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD4_H = 1550
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD4_H))
card4_y = y

# Explanation
exp_f = get_font(46, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, card4_y + 100),
   "Combining years of enrollment with actual learning outcomes reveals stark disparities",
   exp_f, GRAY)

# Two side-by-side bars
bar_w = 140
bar_area_top = card4_y + 280
bar_area_bot = card4_y + CARD4_H - 250
bar_max_h = bar_area_bot - bar_area_top
px_per_year = bar_max_h / 11  # 11 years max scale

left_bar_x = M + int(CW * 0.28)
right_bar_x = M + int(CW * 0.72)

# Poorest countries bar (~2.5 years)
poor_h = int(2.5 * px_per_year)
poor_top = bar_area_bot - poor_h
card(draw, (left_bar_x - bar_w//2, poor_top, left_bar_x + bar_w//2, bar_area_bot),
     fill=AMBER, radius=14)

# Richest countries bar (10 years)
rich_h = int(10 * px_per_year)
rich_top = bar_area_bot - rich_h
card(draw, (right_bar_x - bar_w//2, rich_top, right_bar_x + bar_w//2, bar_area_bot),
     fill=GREEN, radius=14)

# Value labels above bars
val_f = get_font(140, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, poor_top - 110), "< 3", val_f, CORAL)
yr_f = get_font(56, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, poor_top - 180), "years", yr_f, CORAL)

tc(draw, (right_bar_x, rich_top - 110), "10+", val_f, GREEN)
tc(draw, (right_bar_x, rich_top - 180), "years", yr_f, GREEN)

# Labels below bars
below_f = get_font(44, bold=False)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 80), "Poorest countries", get_font(48, bold=True), WHITE)
tc(draw, (left_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 140), "(parts of Sub-Saharan Africa)", below_f, DIM)

tc(draw, (right_bar_x, bar_area_bot + 80), "High-income countries", get_font(48, bold=True), WHITE)

# VS in between
tc(draw, ((left_bar_x + right_bar_x)//2, bar_area_top + bar_max_h//2 - 60), "VS",
   get_font(90, bold=True), DIM)

# Middle section: sub-Sahara / South Asia average
mid_label_y = card4_y + 220
tc(draw, (CX, mid_label_y),
   "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling in wealthy countries",
   get_font(46, bold=True, italic=True), WHITE)

y += CARD4_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5: CLOSING THE GENDER GAP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tc(draw, (CX, y), "05  —  CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD5_H = 900
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD5_H))
card5_y = y

gender_items = [
    ("PRIMARY", "Nearly closed globally", 0.95, GREEN),
    ("SECONDARY", "Nearly closed globally", 0.93, GREEN),
    ("TERTIARY", "Women now exceed men in enrollment", 1.12, AMBER),
]

bar_l = M + 200
bar_r = W - M - 200
bar_w_total = bar_r - bar_l
gen_bar_h = 36

for i, (level, status, ratio, color) in enumerate(gender_items):
    gy = card5_y + 140 + i * 230

    # Level label
    tl(draw, bar_l, gy - 20, level, get_font(52, bold=True), WHITE)

    # Bar bg
    by = gy + 50
    draw.rectangle([bar_l, by, bar_r, by + gen_bar_h], fill=CARD_BG2)

    # Filled portion
    fill_w = int(bar_w_total * min(ratio, 1.05))
    draw.rectangle([bar_l, by, bar_l + fill_w, by + gen_bar_h], fill=color)

    # 100% parity line
    parity_x = bar_l + int(bar_w_total * 1.0)
    hline(draw, parity_x, parity_x, by - 12, GRAY, 2)
    hline(draw, parity_x, parity_x, by + gen_bar_h + 12, GRAY, 2)

    # Status text
    tl(draw, bar_l, by + gen_bar_h + 25, status, get_font(42, bold=False), GRAY)

    # 100% marker
    if i == 0:
        tc(draw, (parity_x, by - 35), "100%\nparity", get_font(30, bold=False), DIM)

    # For tertiary, add an overflow indicator
    if ratio > 1.0:
        tc(draw, (parity_x + 50, by + gen_bar_h//2), "+", get_font(36, bold=True), AMBER)

# Caveat
tc(draw, (CX, card5_y + CARD5_H - 60),
   "Significant exceptions persist — in Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school at any level",
   get_font(34, bold=True, italic=True), DIM)

y += CARD5_H + SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 6: KEY TAKEAWAY
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Final content card
takeaway_h = 500
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+takeaway_h), fill=CARD_BG2, radius=24)
# Left amber accent bar
draw.rectangle([M, y, M+8, y+takeaway_h], fill=AMBER)

tw_f = get_font(48, bold=True)
tw_text = (
    "The world has achieved remarkable progress — but the job is far from done. "
    "Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. "
    "Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning — and between rich and poor nations — "
    "is one of the most pressing challenges of our time."
)

# Manual wrap
words = tw_text.split()
lines = []
cur = ""
for w in words:
    test = cur + " " + w if cur else w
    tww, _ = tw(test, tw_f)
    if tww < CW - 120:
        cur = test
    else:
        lines.append(cur)
        cur = w
if cur:
    lines.append(cur)

txt_y = y + takeaway_h//2 - (len(lines) * 38)
for line in lines:
    tc(draw, (CX, txt_y), line, tw_f, WHITE)
    txt_y += 76

y += takeaway_h + 70

# Source line
src_f = get_font(32, bold=False)
tc(draw, (CX, y),
   "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Our World in Data  (2020–2023)",
   src_f, DIM)
y += 50

# Bottom accent line
hline(draw, CX - 400, CX + 400, y + 30, AMBER, 4)

# ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG")
fsize_mb = os.path.getsize(out) / 1024 / 1024

# Print layout summary
print(f"Saved: {out}")
print(f"Size: {W}x{H}px ({W/DPI:.1f}x{H/DPI:.1f}in) | {fsize_mb:.1f}MB")
print(f"Content fills y=120 to y={y+40} of {H} (bottom margin: {H-(y+40)}px = {(H-(y+40))/DPI:.1f}in)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an A1 portrait poster about global education.
Fully fills the A1 canvas with a data-driven narrative design."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math
import os

# ── A1 at 300 DPI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 7016, 9933
DPI = 300
CX = W // 2  # center x

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG      = (10, 22, 38)       # deep navy
CARD_BG = (22, 35, 53)       # card surface
CARD_BG2 = (28, 43, 62)      # lighter card
AMBER   = (244, 162, 97)     # warm accent
AMBER2  = (255, 183, 77)     # brighter amber
CORAL   = (231, 111, 81)     # urgent accent
WHITE   = (238, 243, 247)    # primary text
GRAY    = (170, 183, 194)    # secondary text
DIM     = (95, 112, 128)     # dim text
GREEN   = (102, 187, 106)    # positive
DARK_ACCENT = (52, 65, 82)   # subtle line

# ── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FB = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
f = lambda name, size: ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FB, name), size)

def get_font(size, bold=True, italic=False):
    if bold and italic:
        return f("LiberationSans-BoldItalic.ttf", size)
    elif bold:
        return f("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", size)
    else:
        return f("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", size)

# ── Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def card(draw, xy, radius=24, fill=CARD_BG):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    r = radius
    draw.rectangle([x1+r, y1, x2-r, y2], fill=fill)
    draw.rectangle([x1, y1+r, x2, y2-r], fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y1, x1+2*r, y1+2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y1, x2, y1+2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x1, y2-2*r, x1+2*r, y2], 90, 180, fill=fill)
    draw.pieslice([x2-2*r, y2, x2, y2], 0, 90, fill=fill)

def hline(draw, x1, x2, y, fill, w=2):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=fill, width=w)

def tc(draw, xy, text, font, fill):
    """Text centered at xy (mm anchor)."""
    draw.text(xy, text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="mm")

def tl(draw, x, y, text, font, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, fill=fill, font=font, anchor="la")

def tw(text, font):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

# ── Layout parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
M = 280                        # margin
CW = W - 2*M                   # content width
HEADER_GAP = 24                # gap between section header and card
SECTION_GAP = 110              # gap between sections

y = 180                        # current vertical position

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 0: TOP BRAND BAR & TITLE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Thin decorative line at top
hline(draw, M, M + 500, 100, AMBER, 5)

# Main title
title_f = get_font(148, bold=True)
sub_f   = get_font(80, bold=True)
desc_f  = get_font(52, bold=False)

ttxt = "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION"
tw1, th1 = tw(ttxt, title_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th1//2), ttxt, title_f, WHITE)
y += th1 + 40

stxt = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
tw2, th2 = tw(stxt, sub_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th2//2), stxt, sub_f, AMBER)
y += th2 + 30

dtxt = "How far the world has come — and the critical gaps that remain"
tw3, th3 = tw(dtxt, desc_f)
tc(draw, (CX, y + th3//2), dtxt, desc_f, GRAY)
y += th3 + 70

# Decorative divider
hline(draw, CX - 500, CX + 500, y, AMBER, 3)
y += SECTION_GAP

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: TWO CENTURIES OF PROGRESS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sec_f   = get_font(48, bold=True)

tc(draw, (CX, y), "01  —  TWO CENTURIES OF EDUCATIONAL EXPANSION", sec_f, AMBER)
y += 80

CARD1_H = 1150
card(draw, (M, y, W-M, y+CARD1_H))
card_y1 = y

# Two big circles: 1800 (1/5) vs TODAY (4/5)
left_x  = M + int(CW * 0.26)
right_x = M + int(CW * 0.74)
cy      = card_y1 + 130

# --- LEFT: 1800 circle ---
lb_f = get_font(42, bold=True)
tc(draw, (left_x, cy), "1800", lb_f, GRAY)

r_small = 195
circle_top = cy + 80
circle_bot = circle_top + 2*r_small
ccy = circle_top + r_small

# Outline circle
draw.ellipse([left_x - r_small, circle_top, left_x + r_small, circle_bot],
             outline=DIM, width=7)
# Fill 1/5 (72 degrees)
